name: A Gnome's Assistance
label: Quest
description: A Gnome's Assistance: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thinking... Thinking... I know I came here for something important...
I have an idea, friend. In the cave over there is a gnome named J.D. That was very kind to me when I first arrived here. Perhaps in my disoriented state, I might have mentioned something to her.
Why don't you go ask her if she knows anything? Oh, but be careful -- she's always messing with those crazy glowing crystals I've seen in the crater. I'm not quite sure what she's up to in there!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Stay where you are for just a moment... I am testing out a new combination of crystals...
